campaign_name: PR-PLAY — Grounded Physical Marking Action Integration
purpose: Bounded end-to-end grounded physical marking during ordinary HTTP play
executive_summary: **A/PASS.** A natural-language marking action now runs in the existing chat turn. It binds an established object, medium, and disclosed text, commits through the existing marking and visibility services, and publishes only after the save. Controlled HTTP copy persists, reloads, replays without a duplicate, restores from snapshots, and is recovered by internal observation. Original T06 is recognized and left unresolved: no garment, medium, or marking is invented. Combined 408 passed / 17 failed before and after, same identities. Focused predecessor selection 574 passed. Live provider calls 0. Next milestone: pr_play_player_marking_observation. Do not begin automatically.

validation: 12 grounded marking tests passed. T06, T04, and post-NPC assertions now expect the grounded unresolved sentence.
tooling: Cycle-local HTTP sequence, performance, and regression runners
generated_artifacts: Bounded HTTP, regression, and hash evidence plus a fresh review archive

testing.focused: 12 passed / 0 failed (grounded marking). Focused predecessor selection after: 574 passed / 0 failed.
testing.broader: Combined before and after: 408 passed / 17 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped (425 tests). New failing identities: none. Newly passing: none. Disclosure historical pair unchanged: 238 passed / 2 failed of 240.
testing.runtime_validation: Controlled HTTP success, original twelve-turn HTTP run, save/reload, snapshots, observation, idempotent replay, and failure injection.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Zero provider calls; providers disabled and non-loopback sockets blocked.
testing.pre_existing_failures: The same 17 combined identities before and after. Historical disclosure KeyError character_secret pair. See REGRESSION_RESULTS.md.

decisions_requiring_human_review: No further authorization required for this bounded implementation.

campaign_specific: Player HTTP projections do not disclose markings. Environmental materials are not inferred. Required consumption and required mechanics stay unresolved. The in-memory request cache returns the first body for a repeated client request id.
pre_existing: Combined 17 failure identities and the disclosure character_secret pair. See REGRESSION_RESULTS.md.

missing_concepts: Player-facing observation of a committed marking.
does_not_prove: A player HTTP observation route, environmental material inference, consumption, mechanical skill checks, full suite, or live-model play.
recommended_next_step: Exactly one recommended next milestone: pr_play_player_marking_observation — player-facing read of an already committed marking through the existing observation and disclosure path. Do not begin automatically.
self_contained_review_test: Reopen the archive and confirm milestone identity, controlled HTTP success, original T06, mutation, visibility, observation, idempotency, save/reload, snapshots, publication ordering, regressions, ruleset portability, and the updated handoff.
